facts.business: Riddhi Siddhi Gluco Biols Limited is an agro-processing company focused on corn wet milling, producing starches, sweeteners, and value-added maize derivatives, with a newly acquired facility at Davangere, Karnataka.

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of corn wet-milling facility at Davangere, Karnataka from Cargill India Private Limited
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Asset Purchase Agreement executed January 2026; acquisition completed April 2026; operations expected to commence October 2026

guidance_or_targets.statement: Operations of the Davangere facility are expected to commence in October 2026, subject to completion of preparatory activities and receipt of requisite approvals.

auditor.name: M/s. Batliboi & Purohit, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: (1) Income tax order for AY 2013-14 to 2020-21 where CIT Appeals upheld additions of ₹308 lakhs; Company filed appeal with ITAT Ahmedabad, shown as contingent liability. (2) SAT order dated March 9, 2026 and Supreme Court order dated March 19, 2026 restraining the Company from accessing or dealing in the securities market.

key_risks: Income tax litigation with upheld additions of ₹308 lakhs for AY 2013-14 to 2020-21, pending appeal at ITAT
Restraint from accessing or dealing in securities market per SAT order (March 9, 2026) and Supreme Court order (March 19, 2026)
Impairment risk on investments in subsidiary Shree Rama Newsprint Limited (SRNPL) aggregating ₹58,041.07 lakhs
Execution risk in commissioning the newly acquired Davangere corn wet-milling facility by October 2026
